body: Advisor notice, 09:56. Since aida-host 29b6c9b, every build through ~/.local/bin/cargo runs with SIGINT and SIGQUIT ignored, and child processes inherit it. Tests that send or trap SIGINT (e.g. bug_0445 a_process_group_interrupt_during_init_behaves_like_ctrl_c) fail on this box for reasons unrelated to the change under test. Such failures are not to be chased or 'fixed' in PRs; CI is unaffected. A fix-forward is in progress, and the advisor will announce when it is live. Ship-blocking builds may set AIDA_CARGO_PRIORITY=high or top to jump the queue. The value 'veryhigh' is silently ignored until the fix lands.
subject: Live cargo wrapper: SIGINT/SIGQUIT are ignored in builds; interrupt-test failures are spurious
